expression: still, back turned — the arc at its coldest
decision; he has heard enough
startled — someone who never moves has moved
addressed, not argued at
listening, defences still up
stated as fact, no heat
the room holding still
the turn — the priest names the protection
recognition landing; he sees the sage differently
unmoved; he has not asked again
certainty
the grip releasing
understanding, wordless, both men
the first easy breath in four films
resolve — he calls, he does not concede
the room changing state
no triumph; he does not smile
the seat he never returned to
a father's hand, and letting go
closed eyes; it is done
glad — not broken. This is the correction.
empty; the boy is not in it yet
